summary: Frontend E2E testing of the new Dynamic Statements (الإفادات) feature via Playwright on the preview URL as admin. All 7 requested scenarios passed: (1) template CRUD in /statement-settings (create 'قالب اختبار آلي', variable chips append into body, edit with label 'حفظ التعديل' + prefilled name/body, delete via window.confirm; existing 'إفادة تقديم للسفارة' untouched); (2) statement modal opens from student-details with 3 mode buttons and nationality field prefilled ('إندونيسي') in standard mode; (3) template mode picker lists the shared template, selection calls /statements/preview-body and fills body fully rendered (zero remaining {placeholders}: 'إندونيسي الجنسية، يدرس بالمستوى الأول تخصص (الشريعة والقانون) ... رقم قيد (1001) وهو مستمر في الدراسة'), edit + issue produced statement 25/2026 with PDF download (statement_25-2026.pdf) and success box; (4) free mode empty body blocked with window.alert 'اكتب متن الإفادة الحرة' and no issuance, then free text issued 26/2026 + PDF; (5) statements-log shows purple type badges '📋 إفادة تقديم للسفارة' / '📋 إفادة حرة' on 23-26/2026 and NO badge on standard 27/2026, 18/2026, 1/2026; (6) public /verify-statement?token=... (no login) shows 'نوع الإفادة' row with template name for 25/2026 and 'إفادة حرة' for the free one, and the row is correctly absent for standard 27/2026; (7) regression: standard mode issued 27/2026 with PDF. No console errors observed in any flow.

issues: Deleting a template gives no success feedback (template-msg is only set on error); list just refreshes silently. Consider a '✅ تم حذف القالب' message for consistency with create/update.

action_items: Optional (minor UX): show a success message in template-msg after a successful template delete.
Note: I added a missing testID — Field component in statement-settings.tsx now forwards testID, and the template name input has data-testid='template-name-input' (kept for future automation).
critical_code_review_comments: student-details.tsx is ~2742 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline; the statement modal + issuing logic is a good candidate to extract into its own component/hook.

onSelectStatementTemplate silently falls back to the raw (un-substituted) template body if /statements/preview-body fails — the user could unknowingly issue a PDF containing {placeholders}. Consider surfacing an error instead of a silent fallback.
seed_data_creation: Created + edited + deleted template 'قالب اختبار آلي'. Issued statements 25/2026 (template), 26/2026 (free), 27/2026 (standard) for student 'طالب اختبار 1' (id 698e57518cfb2f14627a285e). Verify tokens: 25→b7060a0dd16c42199e5786b17eb98acc, 26→f5b010fb6a0e49f7b5f049d94e875455, 27→1c16a6858cf14b5aa3e6a0c73c08b480.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: fill input[0]=username, input[1]=password, then click text 'تسجيل الدخول' (rendered as a div, no role=button). window.confirm/alert must be accepted with asyncio.ensure_future(dialog.accept()) — a plain lambda without awaiting hangs the click. RN Picker renders a native <select>: use select_option(label=...). Template picker option values are template ids. Student details deep link: /student-details?studentId=<id>. Statements 25/26/27 of 2026 were created by this run and can be reused or revoked.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found; the only finding is the missing success toast/message after template deletion (deleteTemplate sets tplMsg only in the catch block).
